title: Market symbol (canonical or venue spelling)
description: A SPELLING of a market, never an identity. Canonical form is 'BASE/QUOTE' with both sides uppercased and no venue prefix, produced by backend/api/internal/markets/instruments/symbol.go CanonicalSymbol and inverted by VenueSymbol; the venue's own spelling (for example 'BTCUSDT') is a different string and is carried in a separate field (exchange_symbol). Venue symbols contain ':…' suffixes for dated instruments ('BTC/USD:BTC-261030'), which is why the canonical form strips anything from ':' onward. Do not key money-bearing rows on this value: the repo's sharpest interoperability gap is that market-data rows carry a canonical 'BASE/QUOTE' string while the executor's VenueKey is 'exchange:market_type:BASE/QUOTE' (frontend/web/src/platform/executor/types.ts venueKey), so the two cannot be joined (canonical-model.md D5).
